notes.title: Game update content
notes.content:
Add some expansion mini games, which can be expanded by clicking the button in the upper right corner of the main menu interface
List of mini games: Gomoku, Void Dragon, Eight Gates, Pyramid Card Game, Snake Greed, Ten Steps Ten Thousand Degrees, Continuous Watching, Tetris, Sudoku, Escape from Maze, Number Huarong Dao, Five Sons Lianzhu
Note: Mini games may not have complete mechanisms and are only for entertainment purposes

notes.title: Game update content
notes.content: Add cache logic adaptation in window mode, even if the window is closed directly while in the game, the current game situation will be cached

notes.content: Add game resolution settings to the game settings interface

notes.title: Recent updates
notes.content:
The game has undergone several updates since its release, and the specific updates are as follows:
1. Add the function of enabling or disabling long press left button flag insertion
2. Add enable/disable right-click flag insertion function
3. Added the option to enable left click drag view/enable right click drag view
4. Add one click flag insertion function for enabling and disabling
5. Add skin system, in addition to the classic style, add two solid color skins, one purple and one green
6. Initial integration into the Steam leaderboard system. Currently, the rule is that after the game is completed, if the current game has a non custom difficulty level and no expansion other than blind scanning is enabled, the score will be automatically uploaded to the online leaderboard. Blind scanning and non blind scanning leaderboards are independent
7. Formally integrated into the achievement system, currently supporting 35 achievements.
